## Course Materials

### Textbook
[**Operating Systems: Three Easy Pieces**](http://pages.cs.wisc.edu/~remzi/OSTEP/)  
by Remzi H. Arpaci-Dusseau and Andrea C. Arpaci-Dusseau

Free online textbook covering all major operating system concepts with clear explanations and practical examples.

### Development Environment
[**Ubuntu VirtualBox VM**](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1jZVQRuomuYsuK5dkTyuVMxV4oNLFX8Hs/view)

Pre-configured Ubuntu virtual machine with all necessary tools and libraries for course assignments.

### Course Code Repository
[**GitHub Repository**](https://github.com/nipunbatra/os2018)

Complete source code for all course materials, including:
- Lecture examples and demonstrations
- Lab exercises and solutions
- Assignment starter code
- Useful utilities and tools

### Local Code Examples
[**Code Examples**](code/)

Local directory containing all code used in lectures and labs:
- Process API examples (fork, exec, wait)
- CPU scheduling simulations
- Memory management programs
- Threading and synchronization examples
- I/O and file system utilities

## Video Lectures

### Complete Course Playlist
[**YouTube Playlist**](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLftoLyLEwECB3NsNfQ1oxtt8IoBNRWcO5)

All 35+ lectures covering the complete operating systems curriculum.

### Supplementary Videos
- [Linux Memory Management](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7aONIVSXiJ8) - Deep dive into Linux memory subsystem
- [Chrome Process Model](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=29e0CtgXZSI) - Understanding multi-process architecture

## Additional Reading

### Classic Papers
- [The Unix Time-Sharing System](https://people.eecs.berkeley.edu/~brewer/cs262/unix.pdf) - Ritchie & Thompson
- [The Design of the UNIX Operating System](https://www.pearson.com/store/p/design-of-the-unix-operating-system-the/P100000312857) - Maurice Bach
- [Modern Operating Systems](https://www.pearson.com/store/p/modern-operating-systems/P100002443471) - Andrew Tanenbaum

### Online Resources
- [OSDev Wiki](https://wiki.osdev.org/) - Comprehensive OS development resource
- [Linux Kernel Documentation](https://www.kernel.org/doc/) - Official Linux kernel docs
- [xv6 Operating System](https://pdos.csail.mit.edu/6.828/2020/xv6.html) - Simple Unix-like teaching OS

## Programming Resources

### C Programming
- [The C Programming Language](https://www.amazon.com/Programming-Language-2nd-Brian-Kernighan/dp/0131103628) - K&R
- [C Reference](https://en.cppreference.com/w/c) - Complete C language reference
- [GDB Tutorial](https://www.gnu.org/software/gdb/documentation/) - Debugging with GDB

### System Programming
- [Advanced Programming in the UNIX Environment](https://www.amazon.com/Advanced-Programming-UNIX-Environment-3rd/dp/0321637739) - Stevens & Rago
- [Linux System Programming](https://www.amazon.com/Linux-System-Programming-Robert-Love/dp/1449339530) - Robert Love
- [The Linux Programming Interface](https://www.amazon.com/Linux-Programming-Interface-System-Handbook/dp/1593272200) - Michael Kerrisk

## Tools and Utilities

### Development Tools
- **GCC**: GNU Compiler Collection
- **GDB**: GNU Debugger
- **Valgrind**: Memory debugging and profiling
- **Make**: Build automation tool

### System Monitoring
- **htop**: Interactive process viewer
- **strace**: System call tracer
- **perf**: Performance analysis tool
- **top**: System resource monitor

### Virtualization
- **VirtualBox**: Desktop virtualization
- **QEMU**: Machine emulator and virtualizer
- **Docker**: Container platform

## Project Ideas

### Open Source Projects
- [xv6](https://github.com/mit-pdos/xv6-public) - Simple Unix-like OS for teaching
- [Minix](https://github.com/Stichting-MINIX-Research-Foundation/minix) - Microkernel-based OS
- [seL4](https://github.com/seL4/seL4) - High-assurance microkernel

### Practice Platforms
- [LeetCode System Design](https://leetcode.com/problemset/concurrency/) - Concurrency problems
- [HackerRank](https://www.hackerrank.com/domains/algorithms) - Algorithm practice
- [Codeforces](https://codeforces.com/) - Competitive programming

## Community and Support

### Forums and Communities
- [Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/operating-system) - Programming Q&A
- [Reddit r/AskComputerScience](https://www.reddit.com/r/AskComputerScience/) - Academic discussions
- [Unix Stack Exchange](https://unix.stackexchange.com/) - Unix/Linux specific questions

### Course Support
- **Office Hours**: Weekly sessions with instructor and TAs
- **Discussion Forum**: Course-specific Q&A platform
- **Email Support**: Direct contact with teaching staff

::: {.callout-tip}
### Study Tips
- Read the textbook chapters before lectures
- Practice coding regularly, not just before assignments
- Join study groups and discuss concepts with peers
- Use multiple resources to understand difficult topics
:::
